value.rationale: When only one Lozi coordinate may receive corrective feedback each step, ordinary per-step global contraction is insufficient because the other stage contains an uncontrolled expanding first-coordinate mode. The sharp two-step stability threshold classifies a natural infinite-parameter family for arbitrary initial conditions and explains the boundary as a continuum of exactly periodic responses rather than an unsupported numerical transition; this is a meaningful dynamical-control boundary.
